_comment: The docs graph's SUB-GRAPHS, declared from within -- the same shape as the base harness's own `docs/docs.json`, paths relative to THIS file's directory.
name: fhir-harness

directories.description: This instance's docs SOURCE: one directory per generated page (`<group>-<slug>/`), holding its authored blocks (`.md`), its manifests (`.ts`) and their generated `.jsonld`. The platform's one docs-page run (`gen-docs-pages.ts`, owner ruling A1 of 2026-10-23: it reads the docs source every mounted instance declares) renders each into the page beside it (`docs/<group>/<slug>.md`), and the site build composes this directory under `/fhir-harness/`. `compose-docs` leaves this directory out, so a block is never published as a page of its own. Moved here from the harness below on 2026-10-24 (bean p9bu): these pages document this layer's own tool and content.
